ms.report:
The primary output for this milestone is the implementation of the Cardano Native Assets basket setup in the backend admin console. 
This setup allows users to:
・View the List of Cardano Native Asset Basket Constituents and Their NAVs: The admin console displays a comprehensive list of the Cardano Native Asset Basket constituents, along with their respective net asset values (NAVs).
・Rebalancing Logic: The rebalancing logic for the basket is clearly outlined, ensuring transparency and ease of management.
・Assigned Balances: Detailed composition and assigned balances of the Cardano Native Assets are available for review.
・Reporting Capabilities: The backend UI facilitates reporting on constituents, rebalancing, and valuations, providing a robust tool for asset management.

Testing and Validation
・Unit Testing: Developers have conducted thorough unit testing of the backend code and configuration, ensuring reliability and performance.
・User Acceptance Testing (UAT): UAT was performed using simulated parameters, validating the functionality and user experience of the backend console.

Evidence of Milestone Completion
To substantiate the completion of this milestone, we have included:
・Screenshots: The attached screenshots illustrate the setup and functionality within the backend admin console - we've added some guidance in red to address the feedback that was shared
・Video Walkthrough: A comprehensive video walkthrough is available at the following link: Video Walkthrough. This video demonstrates the fulfilment of all acceptance criteria, showcasing the development, testing, and project management efforts. 

This submission confirms that all aspects of the milestone have been successfully executed and validated, meeting the specified outputs and acceptance criteria.

ms.report:
Thank you for your thorough review and feedback regarding the Cardano basket index. We appreciate your attention to detail and the concerns raised.
We have revised our documentation to provide greater clarity on our token selection process. The initial asset list was compiled in September 2024 for development and testing purposes, with the understanding that the final constituent list would be determined closer to the actual launch date, most likely during milestone 3 execution.
We acknowledge that as first-time participants in the Catalyst process, we were unaware that Milestone 2 review could only commence after Milestone 1's full sign-off. Now that Milestone 1 has received approval, we are eager to proceed correctly with Milestone 2, ensuring all documentation meets the required standards.
Our team remains committed to launching this Cardano basket for our 10,000-strong user base, particularly given current market conditions. We believe this product will add significant value to the Cardano ecosystem.
Please let us know if you require any additional information or clarification.
----------------------------------------------------------------
